preconditions.description: The length of the genome n must be between 4 and 255 inclusive.
The length of the string s must be equal to the given length n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ACGT?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of the characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '===' or len([c for c in stdout if c in 'ACGT']) == n // 4 * 4
postconditions.description: If the genome cannot be decoded, the output must be '==='. Otherwise, the output must contain exactly n/4 occurrences of each nucleotide type.

postconditions.expression: any(c == '?' for c in s) and stdout != '==='
postconditions.description: If the input contains any '?' and the output is not '===', then the output must replace each '?' with a valid nucleotide.

postconditions.expression: stdout == s if all(c in 'ACGT' for c in s) else True
postconditions.description: If the input does not contain any '?', the output must be the same as the input.
